_comment: ThreeCardMonte locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{steps}: The total number of shuffle steps
_slots.{i}: The first cup index involved in a swap
_slots.{j}: The second cup index involved in a swap
_slots.{prompt}: The localized prompt fragment appended after the cups
_slots.{max_index}: The highest valid cup index, i.e. num_cups-1
_slots.{ball_pos}: The cup index the ball is under

player_prompt.intro:
Landula mbole ya kuzingirwa 'X' kufwasa mikwanga ikusokelwa.
Kufwasa kusokelwa, kamba kweji kwau nge ` [k]`.

game_message.guess_now: (Ijiia ihi i ua tokala o ku bhanga kindala!)

outcome.lose: O bola ia kexile bhoxi dia kopho. {ball_pos}
